import java.util.*;

    static int[][] ir = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] sc = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] pc = new int[20][20];
    static char[][] s = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] p = new char[20][20];
    static int[][] dd = new int[20][20];

    static int[] dy = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static List<Integer>[][] ns = new List[20][20];
    static List<Integer>[][] np = new List[20][20];
    
    static void ade(int a, int b) {
        e[a].add(b);
        e[b].add(a);
    }
    
    static int[] ds = new int[2020];
    static int[] pa = new int[2020];
    static int sp, pp;
    
    static boolean bfs() {
        Deque<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= sp; i++) {
            if (pa[i] == 0) {
                ds[i] = 0;
                q.add(i);
            } else {
                ds[i] = 3010;
            }
        }
        ds[0] = 3010;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.pollFirst();
            if (ds[u] < ds[0]) {
                for (int i = 0; i < e[u].size(); i++) {
                    int v = pa[e[u].get(i)];
                    if (ds[v] > ds[u] + 1) {
                        ds[v] = ds[u] + 1;
                        q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return ds[0] != 3010;
    }
    
    static boolean dfs(int x) {
        if (x == 0) {
            return true;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < e[x].size(); i++) {
            int u = pa[e[x].get(i)];
            if (ds[u] == ds[x] + 1) {
                if (dfs(u)) {
                    pa[x] = e[x].get(i);
                    pa[e[x].get(i)] = x;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    static int hkp() {
        int an = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= sp; i++) {
                if (pa[i] == 0) {
                    an += dfs(i);
                }
            }
        }
        return an;
    }
    
    static int n, t;
    
    static void wk(int a, int b) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                dd[i][j] = 100000;
            }
        }
        Deque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        dd[a][b] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{a, b});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.pollFirst();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < np[x][y].size(); i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < ns[a][b].size(); j++) {
                    ade(ns[a][b].get(j), np[x][y].get(i));
                }
            }
            if (dd[x][y] == ir[x][y]) {
                continue;
            }
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d];
                int ny = y + dy[d];
                if (sc[nx][ny] != -1 && dd[nx][ny] > dd[x][y] + 1 && dd[x][y] + 1 <= ir[nx][ny]) {
                    dd[nx][ny] = dd[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        t = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                ir[i][j] = t;

            String line = br.readLine();
            p[i] = line.toCharArray();

        int rx = 0, ry = 0;
        sp = 1;
        pp = 1000;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (s[i][j] == 'Z' || s[i][j] == 'Y') {
                    sc[i][j] = -1;
                    ir[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (s[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    rx = i;
                    ry = j;
                    ir[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (s[i][j] >= '0' && s[i][j] <= '9') {
                    sc[i][j] = s[i][j] - '0';
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < sc[i][j]; k++) {
                    if (ns[i][j] == null) {
                        ns[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                    }
                    ns[i][j].add(sp++);
                }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {

                for (int k = 0; k < pc[i][j]; k++) {
                    if (np[i][j] == null) {

                    np[i][j].add(pp++);
                }
            }
        }
        
        Deque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(new int[]{rx, ry});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.pollFirst();
            rx = cur[0];
            ry = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = rx + dx[d];
                int ny = ry + dy[d];
                if (ir[nx][ny] > ir[rx][ry] + 1 && sc[nx][ny] != -1) {
                    ir[nx][ny] = ir[rx][ry] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (sc[i][j] > 0) {
                    wk(i, j);
                }

        }
        
        System.out.println(hkp());
    }
}
